name: AzelaiK 12% Micro Emulsion
one_line: A micronized 12% azelaic acid treatment for breakouts, post-acne marks, and reactive redness.
ingredient_summary: 12% micronized azelaic acid in a micro-emulsion base (Olivem 1000, caprylic/capric triglycerides, cetyl alcohol) with glycerin, butylene glycol, propanediol, betaine, panthenol, and green tea; pH 5.0–5.5.
reason_phrases: Micronized azelaic acid tackles active breakouts and the marks they leave, in one step.
A treatment built for reactive, breakout-prone skin that doesn't tolerate harsh actives.
caution: Patch test if skin is highly reactive. Use SPF daily.

name: NiAbutin C Serum
one_line: A gentle daily brightening serum layering ascorbyl glucoside, alpha arbutin, and niacinamide.
ingredient_summary: Ascorbyl glucoside 5%, alpha arbutin 2%, niacinamide 2%, panthenol, sodium hyaluronate, licorice and mulberry extracts, green tea; pH ~5.2.
reason_phrases: A layered brightening complex designed for daily use without the sting of pure vitamin C.
Targets unevenness and mild pigmentation while staying comfortable on sensitive skin.
caution: Use SPF daily for best brightening results.

name: GlycoGommage Exfoliator
one_line: A rinse-off peeling gel with 3% glycolic acid and microcrystalline cellulose for texture and dullness.
ingredient_summary: 3% glycolic acid + microcrystalline cellulose in a rinse-off gel, with aloe juice and allantoin; pH 5.0–5.2.
reason_phrases: Gentle dual exfoliation — chemical + physical — in a rinse-off format.
Resurfaces texture and lifts dullness without leaving skin raw.
caution: Use 1–2× weekly. Not for reactive, broken, or actively inflamed skin. Always follow with SPF.

name: MatchaMelt Balm
one_line: A melting cleansing balm that dissolves makeup and SPF without stripping the barrier.
ingredient_summary: Anhydrous balm of caprylic/capric triglyceride, C12-15 alkyl benzoate, high-oleic sunflower oil, synthetic beeswax, cetearyl alcohol, and PEG emulsifiers for rinse-off; oil-soluble green tea.
reason_phrases: A balm-to-oil cleanse that lifts makeup and SPF cleanly, leaving the barrier intact.
For anyone whose cleanser strips too much.

name: DermaSeal Barrier Cream
one_line: A ceramide-rich occlusive cream for dryness, tightness, and barrier recovery.
ingredient_summary: Glycerin + sodium PCA humectants, mineral oil + squalane occlusives, ceramide NP, cetearyl alcohol, bearberry, green tea; pH 5.4–5.6.
reason_phrases: A ceramide + squalane seal for skin that feels tight, flaky, or over-exfoliated.
Use as an overnight mask or a weekly barrier reset.

name: HydraPep Serum
one_line: A triple-weight hyaluronic acid serum with 3% Matrixyl 3000 for hydration and early fine lines.
ingredient_summary: Three molecular weights of hyaluronic acid, 3% Matrixyl 3000, glycerin, panthenol; pH 5.3–5.7.
reason_phrases: Multi-depth hydration paired with a clinically used peptide complex for early fine lines.
Layerable under anything else in the routine.

name: BHA Gentle Cleanser
one_line: A 1% salicylic acid cleanser that clears congestion without stripping the barrier.
ingredient_summary: 1% salicylic acid in a mild surfactant base (cocamidopropyl betaine, decyl glucoside, sodium lauroyl methyl isethionate) with niacinamide, panthenol, and sodium hyaluronate.
reason_phrases: Daily BHA cleanse that keeps pores clear without drying the rest of your skin out.
For oily, congested, and breakout-prone skin.

name: Tranexamilk Toner
one_line: A 4% tranexamic acid emulsion for melasma, stubborn dark spots, and post-acne pigmentation.
ingredient_summary: 4% tranexamic acid in a milky emulsion (Olivem 1000, caprylic/capric triglycerides, cetyl alcohol) with betaine, glycerin, panthenol, allantoin, and a low dose of lactic acid.
reason_phrases: Targeted tranexamic acid for the pigmentation that brighteners alone rarely shift.
A milky, comfortable emulsion — no classic vitamin C sting.
caution: Use SPF daily — pigmentation treatments require sun protection.
